message: No runtime checks have run yet, so this Google Cloud RAG design is still unvalidated. The empty failures list doesn't mean the design passed. All 8 blockers have the same cause. There's no supported Google Cloud setup yet for the web app, Identity Platform, RAG API, Firestore catalog, Gemini or the indexer, and none for the two existing callers. The only Google Cloud setup it supports is private object storage, and switching to that would reduce the app to storage, which you've ruled out. The supported bounded keyword RAG setup with web sign-in exists only on AWS. Editing the diagram can't fix this. Someone has to build the Google Cloud parts: Cloud Run web and API apps, Identity Platform token checks, a Firestore catalog with permission lists and document versions, the Eventarc indexer and a Vertex AI Gemini connection. They'd use this artifact (design revision 2, artifact c06fd713…) to reproduce the problem. So I haven't changed the board. Should we keep Google Cloud and log this as build work to do, or also run the same five acceptance checks on the supported AWS setup? That would test the logic locally while Google Cloud stays the chosen platform. Either way, a scripted model wouldn't prove real Gemini quality.
